description: The failure-phase cases (templates.md §14.4; C09). One case per new code with the exact raising state. The checker re-derives the pure parts (digests, recipe rules, resolution); the workspace-phase states (marker/on-disk) are the pinned 72/73 evidence expectations.

cases.state: creation names a templateId not in the installed verified set (removed, or never installed)
cases.resolution: nothing written; the install scan row reports the installed set only

cases.state: a descriptor with an unknown field, a wrong schemaVersion/type, or a blobs entry unsorted / with an invalid path (.., escape, or a symlink component)
cases.resolution: install scan reports + excludes the template; creation naming it ⇒ template_not_found (never loaded)

cases.state: any of the three digest checks fails: descriptor-minus-digest re-hash ≠ contentDigest; recipe re-hash ≠ recipeDigest; a sources file re-hash/length ≠ its inventory row (a tampered file)
cases.resolution: the template is refused for creation and reported by the scan; no field is ever repaired from another field

cases.state: backend engineVersion ≠ the descriptor engineVersion (carries both)
cases.resolution: creation refused before the reserved phase (nothing written)

cases.state: a template file path escapes templatesRoot, uses .., or any path component is a symlink (realpath containment fails)
cases.resolution: the template is refused at install scan (and at creation); the symlink case is never followed

cases.state: three sub-cases: (a) an op outside the §4.1 whitelist (e.g. deleteEntity or publishBehavior — the behavior boundary, templates.md §4.1/§8.4); (b) a bound (N > 128, recipe > 256 KiB, blobs > 64); (c) a replayed command fails validation at creation (a command index i fails ⇒ the error carries index i + the command error)
cases.resolution: (a)/(b) at install scan (the template is refused — a committed recipe that does not replay is invalid, §4.3); (c) at the replayed phase (the marker is retained at the last good command; the destination stays resumable/deletable, never ready)

cases.state: the destination exists with a different identity: different template/digest, different name, a non-template (v1-manifest or migrated) project, a partial destination of a different identity, or an unloadable directory (carries existing: project|partial|unloadable)
cases.resolution: nothing written; the existing project is never overwritten/renamed/upgraded; the identity-matching retry is the §5.2 no-op (created:false)

cases.state: a foreign reservation marker (different identity) is observed for the same destination at the reserved phase (concurrent different-identity claim)
cases.resolution: the loser is refused; the winner proceeds; no marker is overwritten

cases.state: the marker and the on-disk state disagree unrecoverably: recipeApplied ≠ the envelope revision; a corrupt published phase at revision < N; a manifest that does not re-derive from the reservation identity
cases.resolution: no auto-completion; the scan reports; the operator deletes the destination (or resumes when the disagreement is a simple resume gap)

cases.state: any open/query/Play/project-list against a destination with a marker phase < published (carries phase, recipeApplied, the resume/delete hint)
cases.resolution: the destination is not a project: it never appears as loadable; only the published+claimed+marker-removed state is ready (the C09 invariant)

cases.state: an in-flight creation (marker phase < published) whose marker templateContentDigest matches no installed template (a replacement landed across a crash)
cases.resolution: reported by the scan; resolved by restoring the original template (then resume) or deleting the destination; never re-pointed, never auto-completed

cases.state: a declared or content-derived module ID is not in the finite §8.1 registry (at any evaluation point §8.3)
cases.resolution: creation fails before published (reported at the marker); capture/export fail the snapshot build with the exact code; post-edit Play is refused with it

cases.state: the resolved set would contain the same ID twice (a registry-integrity fault — the resolution is a set union over a flat registry, so this is a registry-validation failure)
the registry dependency edges carry a cycle (impossible for the flat M4 registry — a registry-integrity check specified so a future row cannot smuggle one in)
the delivery capture of a scene whose content references thirdlight.behavior:<id> (a user-added behavior, §8.4): the module is referenced but not linkable under the M4 built-in-only profile
cases.resolution: the capture fails with the exact code — never a silent omission (C14), never a silent fallback (the host fail-closed, CC-55-3a, is the same boundary at the host layer)

cases.state: a manifest schemaVersion 2 paired with storageVersion ≤ 2 (the §6 named-combination check)
cases.resolution: the load pipeline refuses with version_combination_unsupported (single error); the only new valid combination is (2, 3, 3)

cases.state: the destination quota / device free space cannot hold the template blobs (checked before the blobs phase; kind: project_quota | device_space)
cases.resolution: the reserved marker is retained; nothing half-published; resumable after space, operator-deletable

cases.state: a W failure (ENOSPC/EIO) in the blobs/envelope phases (the accepted content_publish_failed with the onDiskState)
cases.resolution: the marker stays at the last completed phase; never half-claimed, never ready (§5.7)

crashTable: the §5.6 phase table is the crash-completion spec; the 72/73 evidence drills each boundary (subprocess crash at reserved/blobs/envelope/replayed(K<N)/published-unclaimed) and asserts the no-ready-partial invariant (C09).
